capabilities: create notes in configured folder paths via commands
apply Templater templates automatically on note creation
build dynamic paths with variables, regex, and moment.js date formats
control file naming, title incrementing, and post-creation focus
provide a quick-switcher command covering unregistered folders
extras: Focusing the inline title uses a hard-coded 50ms timeout that may need manual tuning in data.json on slow machines; installation via BRAT and manual release download is also documented.
intentEvidence: This functionality enables you to replicate the behavior of "Folder Templates."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define per-folder commands that create notes with preset paths, names, and templates.

relations.evidence: If you have the Templater plugin installed and configured, you can assign a template to a note.
This functionality enables you to replicate the behavior of "Folder Templates."
Many thanks to @SilentVoid13 and @RafaelGB for their Templater and dbFolder

summary: Command-based note creator that adds commands to create notes in preset folders with variable paths, custom naming, and Templater templates.
